headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds rallied past the Chicago White Sox 9-8, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Abner Uribe, a right-handed pitcher for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. Additionally, Colt Emerson of the Seattle Mariners has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation.

The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox, while the Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. Tejay Antone earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out 3 batters in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Marlins 13-1 Behind Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 13-1 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Braxton Ashcraft leading the way on the mound. Ashcraft pitched 9.0 innings, striking out 10 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. Weston Wilson led the Mariners' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 0-3 loss to the Chicago Cubs, marking a tough outing for the team. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense, while Matthew Liberatore struggled on the mound for the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Brewers RHP Abner Uribe Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox on August 12, 2026, as part of a trade. The deal also included a player to be named later from the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
